title: Doors (market/doors.json)
description: Events, conferences, communities and programmes where people from the target organisations can be met, each with a date, a place, a link and its source. Written by scripts/fetch_doors.py and scripts/doors.py. Progress only: score.py never reads this file. Each door can become a plan action (scripts/doors.py plan). LVLme never registers, RSVPs, applies or pays.

extension.description: Extension field: any key starting x_ holds data the engine never reads. Kept as is.

orgs.description: Target ids from config.json the door is about. Empty: near the person, not at a target.

starts_on.description: The day it happens, in the person's time zone.

time.description: Local start time, in the person's time zone.

link.description: Where the person registers or reads more. They register themselves.

source.description: Where the facts come from: the calendar feed, the posting or the page.

verified.description: The lead opened the source itself (a calendar feed or a job board read by a script counts).

uid.description: The calendar's event id or the posting id, so a later fetch updates this door instead of adding it again.

dimension.description: The factor this door can move: usually warm path (D3) for meeting people, organisation-specific edge (D4) for a programme.

done_when.description: Something the person can show, such as the name of one person they spoke with.

action.description: The plan action made from this door, if any.
